digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler backend port / adapter seam
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) directly import adapters.jira, violating the vendor-neutral backend port abstraction mandated by epic bbf1

The Backend Protocol must expose scalar, translation-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) with identical semantics to current Jira resolve_jira_settings behavior, eliminating vendor-specific imports
New neutral exceptions BackendEnvError and BackendAssigneeNotFoundError must replace vendor-specific error handling to maintain adapter abstraction at the core/port boundary
All four modules contain nested (function-level) lazy imports of adapters.jira that require full-tree AST analysis to detect and remove, not just top-level import scanning

The Backend port scalar surface must remain translation-only and parameterized only on universal concerns (project scope, env readiness, assignee errors), not vendor-specific shapes like Jira field dicts
